title: claude-provider-switcher profile
description: Profile schema for claude-provider-switcher v0.1.0. Machine-readable companion to docs/design.md §3. Enforcement lives in scripts/validate-profile.ps1.

name.description: Profile identifier. MUST equal the filename basename.

base_url.description: LLM endpoint URL. MUST be https:// except for localhost/127.0.0.1.

target.description: Windows Credential Manager generic-credential target name. Pattern rejects shell metacharacters.

model.description: Default model for new sessions. Written as the top-level `model` key in settings.local.json.

extras.description: Free-form env vars for the session. Keys MUST NOT appear in the extras denylist (docs/design.md §3). Enforced at validate-time and apply-time.
